title: Nyxa launches live stats overlay for AFL matches
dek: Disposals, inside 50s and clearances update in real time next to Nyxa's live markets.
body:
Nyxa has launched a live statistics overlay for AFL matches. Key numbers such as disposals, inside 50s and clearances update next to the live markets in the app, so customers can follow how a match is going without switching to another screen. This partner piece explains what the overlay shows and the limits that sit alongside it.

What the overlay shows

The overlay appears above the live markets for every AFL Premiership match this season. It draws on an official data feed and updates within a few seconds of play.

  • Team numbers: disposals, inside 50s, clearances, tackles and marks inside 50.
  • Scoring: goals, behinds and scoring shots by quarter.
  • Momentum: a simple bar showing which team has had more inside 50s in the last five minutes.
  • Player stats: top disposal winners and goal kickers for each side.

Customers can collapse the overlay to a single line or switch it off completely in settings.

Why Nyxa built it

According to Nyxa, customers who bet in-play were leaving the app to check stats elsewhere and coming back, which made it harder to follow a match calmly. Bringing the numbers into one place is meant to give a clearer picture of what is actually happening on the field, rather than reacting to a single passage of play.

Built-in limits

The overlay comes with the same safer-betting tools as the rest of the app, and a few that are specific to live betting:

ToolWhat it does
Session reminderShows how long you have been in live markets, every 30 minutes by default
Deposit limitRemaining amount shown in the bet slip; lowering applies immediately
Take a breakPauses the account for a period you choose
Activity statementMonthly summary of deposits, bets and net result

Session reminders can be set to 15, 30 or 60 minutes. Nyxa says they cannot be switched off entirely while live markets are open.

A note on live betting in Australia

Under Australian law, in-play betting on sport is only available by phone or at retail venues, not through online "click to bet" during play, while some providers offer live markets through compliant channels. Customers should check how live markets work in the Nyxa app before relying on them, and remember that live prices move fast.

The takeaway

The overlay is a useful way to follow a match in one screen. If you use it, set your session reminder and deposit limit first, and treat live markets with extra care.
